title: This Snake Touches the Burning Sand at Just Two Points
subject: sidewinder rattlesnake

scenes.text: This snake moves across scorching sand without ever really touching it.
The sidewinder throws its body sideways in loops, and only two parts of it are on the ground at once.
Everything else is in the air, away from sand hot enough to cook it.
That leaves the J-shaped tracks you see in the dunes, and it lets the snake reach about 18 miles an hour.
Loose sand gives way under a straight crawl, but this sideways motion grips it.
Two points of contact. That is the whole trick.

description:
This snake moves across scorching sand without ever really touching it.
A sidewinder keeps only two points of its body on the ground at a time, which helps it avoid overheating.
Would you cross the desert like that?
